o.text: Equivalent to baş (“head”) + -la. Cognate with Turkish başlamak. Probably from Proto-Turkic, compare Chuvash пуҫла (puśla, “to start”, transitive).
Borrowed from Classical Persian هَیکَل (haykal), from Arabic هَيْكَل (haykal).

From *yörgek (“baby swaddling cloth”), from Proto-Turkic *yörge- (“wrap, swathe”).
Cognate with
Azerbaijani yırğalamaq,
Azerbaijani yorğan,
Turkish yorgan,
Bashkir йүргәк (yörgäk),
Kazakh жөргек (jörgek),
Uzbek yoʻrgak,
Uyghur يۈگەك (yügek),
Tuvan чөргек (çörgek, “baby swaddling cloth”).
